• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tid2013_published() -> 'Dict[str, Tuple[float, float]]' (to call the implementation directly, import iqatid; iqatid.tid2013_published() -> 'Dict[str, Tuple[float, float]]'; from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("tid2013_published"))

Usage

The published rank-correlation table {metric: (SROCC, KROCC)} (14 metrics).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

出典: https://www.ponomarenko.info/tid2013.htm(Last changed 2015-03-23)の「Ranking of compared metrics in accordance with Spearman / Kendall correlation with MOS」、配布物 readme の TABLE III / IV と同一。鍵は配布物 metrics_values/<鍵>.txt のファイル名(小文字)。同梱の作者値と mos.txt から、Spearman = 平均順位・Kendall = τ_b で 14 本すべて 3 桁一致 (|差| ≤ 0.0005 / 0.00044、2026-10-04)。ページ冒頭の「PSNR … is 0.69」と使用例の「FSIMc Full : 0.666」は表と食い違う(前者は TID2008 の名残、後者は τ_a 0.66626 に一致 —— どちらも推測)ので門には使わない。
